text: Analysis window: orders purchased from 2017-01-01 to 2018-08-31. Column in_window = 1 marks orders and items inside it.
plain: Analysis window: Orders purchased from 2017-01-01 to 2018-08-31 (see data quality log, issue 2)

text: Order: one row in fact_orders. Items of an order are rows in fact_order_items with the same order_id.

Delivered order: order_status 'delivered' with a delivery date; column is_delivered = 1. Revenue metrics use is_revenue_order = 1 (fact_orders) or is_revenue_item = 1 (fact_order_items), meaning delivered AND inside the analysis window.
plain: Delivered order: Order with status `delivered` and a delivered-to-customer date

text: Revenue: SUM(fact_order_items.price) WHERE is_revenue_item = 1 (delivered orders in the analysis window). Freight is not included.
plain: Revenue: Sum of item `price` for delivered orders. Freight is not included

text: Freight revenue: SUM(fact_order_items.freight_value) WHERE is_revenue_item = 1, reported separately from revenue.
plain: Freight revenue: Sum of `freight_value` for delivered orders, reported separately

text: Average order value (AOV): revenue divided by the number of delivered orders, i.e. SUM(price) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) over fact_order_items WHERE is_revenue_item = 1.
plain: Average order value (AOV): Revenue divided by number of delivered orders

text: Customer: a person, identified by customer_unique_id (not by order).
Active customer in a month: a customer_unique_id with at least one order WHERE is_revenue_order = 1 purchased in that month (fact_orders.purchase_date).
plain: Active customer (month): Customer with at least one delivered order in that month

text: Repeat customer: a customer_unique_id with two or more orders WHERE is_revenue_order = 1.
plain: Repeat customer: Customer with two or more delivered orders in the analysis window

text: Repeat rate: repeat customers divided by all customers with at least one order WHERE is_revenue_order = 1, usually shown as a percentage.
plain: Repeat rate: Repeat customers divided by all customers with at least one delivered order

text: Delivery days: fact_orders.delivery_days, the delivered date minus the purchase date in whole days. estimated_days is the promised number of days.
plain: Delivery days: Date delivered to customer minus purchase date, in whole days

text: Late delivery: fact_orders.is_late = 1, the delivered date is later than the estimated delivery date.
plain: Late delivery: Delivered date is later than the estimated delivery date

text: Late rate: late delivered orders divided by delivered orders, i.e. AVG(is_late) over fact_orders WHERE is_revenue_order = 1, usually shown as a percentage.
plain: Late rate: Late delivered orders divided by delivered orders with a delivery date

text: Review score: fact_orders.review_score, one review per order, 1 to 5; NULL when the order has no review.
plain: Review score: One review per order (latest), 1 to 5
Low review: Review score of 1 or 2

text: Seller-customer distance: straight-line km between seller and customer; fact_order_items.distance_km per item, fact_orders.avg_distance_km and max_distance_km per order.
plain: Seller-customer distance: Straight-line (haversine) distance in km between the seller and customer zip-prefix centres

text: Revenue per 1,000 residents: state revenue divided by the state population (dim_customer.state_population), times 1,000.
plain: Revenue per 1,000 residents: State revenue divided by IBGE state population (1 July 2018), times 1,000
